name: OpenAI key, project and service-account identifiers
description: Identifiers in OpenAI's Administration API reference: a project API key id (shown as key_abc), a project id (proj_abc) and a service account id (svc_acct_abc), also passed in headers such as OpenAI-Project. The reference describes them as identifiers that can be referenced in API endpoints. They appear next to key values in the same responses and configuration, which is why a reader may confuse them with the key; no page read states a grammar for these identifiers or says anything about whether they are confidential.

sources.supports: ProjectAPIKey.id is the identifier which can be referenced in API endpoints; example id key_abc.
Example response with service account id svc_acct_abc and key id key_abc; project path parameter proj_abc.
Organization and project IDs are found in dashboard settings and are passed in OpenAI-Organization and OpenAI-Project headers.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Class is unresolved because the sources document the identifier role and example spellings only, not a format and not non-confidentiality; an identifier role is not extended to a benign-expectation basis.
